newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Monsanto EPS upside seen.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Monsanto EPS upside seen.

text.p: -- PaineWebber analyst Paul Raman said he expected an upside surprise in Monsanto Co's third quarter earnings, according to a PaineWebber source.

-- Raman said he estimates Monsanto's third quarter earnings at $0.22 a share, but added that the company might report results as high as $0.25 to $0.30. Monsanto earned $0.20 in the 1995 third quarter.

-- He said sales of Monsanto's herbicide, Roundup, are strong; its chemical business is benefitting from a 10 percent price increase in nylon; and its biotech products are beginning to show positive results.
-- Ramon maintains his buy rating on the stock.
